title: Electricity - 123 school
heading: Electricity
intro: Test your knowledge by typing your answer and comparing it with the correct answer. Then click 'Check answers'.

questions.q: What does a generator do?
questions.a: It converts kinetic energy into electrical energy

questions.q: What is a power station?
questions.a: A place where electrical energy is generated

questions.q: Why is high voltage used to transport electricity over long distances?
questions.a: Less energy is then lost as heat in the cables

questions.q: What does a transformer do?
questions.a: It makes the voltage higher or lower

questions.q: What is a kilowatt-hour?
questions.a: The energy used by a 1 kW appliance in 1 hour

What does a fuse do?
questions.a: It breaks the circuit when the current is too high

questions.q: What is overload?
questions.a: Too many appliances are connected at the same time, so the current becomes too high

questions.q: What is a short circuit?
questions.a: The current flows along a path with almost no resistance

questions.q: What does a residual-current device (RCD) do?
questions.a: It switches off the current if current leaks away to earth

questions.q: What is the earth wire for?
questions.a: For safety if an appliance develops a fault

questions.q: Why must you not touch a socket with wet hands?
questions.a: Water conducts electric current, so you could get an electric shock
